subject: wo-exp-pri
title: WO.EXP.PRI. ----PROG.CONT.
description: Diagram in AE(PD)-27, first of two on book p139, on the page where Braxton argues that 'the spectacle-diversion syndrome is the progressional platform underlying how events on the physical universe level are manipulated and perceived — as a controlling factor that moves to affect one's ability to participate in actual life or relevant change.' WO-EXP-PRI (world expansion principle) is crossed with PROG-CONT (progressional continuance): the question is what world-expansion produces when crossed with progressional-continuance in a culture where the spectacle-diversion is the progressional platform itself. EXP-DY (expansion dynamics) branches from the main line near the subject and carries OP-SD (option spread) and ACC-DY (accelerated dynamics), from whose line METH (methodology) and SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics) branch. TR (transformation) branches from the main line to the right and carries COS-P (cosmic particulars), from which INFO-INTG (information integration) branches, and PHY-U-C (physical universe context), which leads to POL-DY (political dynamics) and on to RT-ALGN (reality alignment). INFO-SOLD (information solidification) branches from the main line to the left and carries STF (source transfer), whose line leads to APP-RDEF (applied redefinitions); RE-ST (restructuralism) and RE-CONT (recontinuance) branch from the APP-RDEF line, and AF-NT (affinity nature) from the RE-CONT line.
